value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Clovis/Fresno County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Standard plan and checklist of all requirements, published on the City's website, substantially conforming to the California Solar Permitting Guidebook

required_documents.notes: Per Clovis Municipal Code Section 8.14.05(a),(d)-(e): the Building Department adopts a standard plan and checklist substantially conforming to the CA Solar Permitting Guidebook, made available on the City's website.

value: Only one inspection shall be required and performed by the Building Department for eligible small residential rooftop solar energy systems (a separate fire inspection may be performed if deemed required by the Clovis Fire Department)

The inspection shall be done in a timely manner and should include consolidated inspections; an inspection will be scheduled within two business days of a request and provide a four-hour inspection window
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized

value.notes: Clovis Municipal Code Section 8.14.06(a): the Building Department 'shall issue a permit or other nondiscretionary permit the following business day for over-the-counter applications which are deemed complete or within three (3) business days for electronic applications' of receipt of a complete application.

timeline_days.notes: Directly confirmed this session via the City's own municipal code (Chapter 8.14), replacing the prior search-engine-derived, unconfirmed value with the same figures now independently verified.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Systems expedited permitting (Clovis Municipal Code Chapter 8.14)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City of Clovis

permit_fees.notes: Search-engine synthesis indicates a 'new fee structure' exists on the city's Building web page, but no specific dollar figure was found or independently confirmed this session.
